FOREWORD This Indian Standard ( First Revision ) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards, after the draft finalized by the Pesticides Sectional Committee had been approved by the Food and Agriculture Division Council. Temephos is the accepted common name by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) for the 0, 0,0', O'-tetramethyl 0, 0' -thiodi-p-phenylene bis (phosphorothioate). The empirical and structural formulae and the molecular mass of temephos are indicated below:
Empirical Formula Structural Formula Molecular Mass

Cd2006P2S3

466.5

Temephos, technical is employed in the preparation of pesticides formulations. The product has been registered for production and use in the country under the provisions of Insecticides Act, 1968 and the Rules framed thereunder. In the preparation of this standard, due consideration has, therefore, been given to the provisions-of the Act and the Rules framed thereunder as well as Standards of Weights and Measures (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 1977. However, this standard is subject to therestrictions imposed under these, wherever applicable. This standard was first published in 1978. This standard has been revised to incorporate: of temephos content in addition to spectrophotometric method,

a) HPLC method for determination b) Amendment No. 1, and c) update referred standards.

For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS 2-: 1960 `Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised )`. The number of significant ' places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

A-O Either of the two methods, namely, HPLC method (A-l) or Spectrophotometric method (A-2) shall be used for determination of temephos content but HPLC method shall be the referee method. A-l HIGH PERFORMANCE LIQUID CIIROMATOGRAPHN=METFIOD A-l.1 Principle HPLC unit, equipped with a UV detector , is used for estimation of temephos content. A solution containing known amounts of the reference standard and internal is injected into the HPLC unit. Subsequently temephos sample is injected and the percentage of temephos in the sample is then computed by the standard relationship. A-l.2 Apparatus A-1.2.1 High Performance

A-2,1 Principle
of Internal Standard Solution

Weigh 0.12 14 g ofp-nitrophenylp-nitrobenzoate into 50-ml volumetric flask and make up the volume to the mark with mobile phase n-Hexane : Ethyl acetate ( 95 : 5 v/v ). A-1.4.2 Preparafion
Solution of Reference Standard

The sample is dissolved in ethyl acetate and hexane and chromatographed on silica gel to remove interfering substances. The chromatographed solution is evaporated to dryness, the residue taken np in methanol, and the ultraviolet absorbance of the methanol solution is compared with a temephos standard treated in the same way.
A-2.2 Apparatus Column

Weigh 0.033 3 g of reference standard temephos of known purity in 50-ml volumetric flask. Add 5 ml internal standard solution ~( see A-1.4.1 ) and make up the volume to the mark with mobile phase n-Hexane : Ethyl acetate ( 95 : 5 v/v ). A-1.4.3 Preparation
of Sample Solution

known

A-4.1 Prepare a column for each of the samples to be assayed, plus one for the reference standard. Fill the lOO-ml glass chromatographic column with hexane. Weigh 20 f 0.1 g of silica gel and slowly add to the column. Stopper and shake well. Allow the silica gel to settle. Rinse down the column with hexane to remove any silica gel adhering to the column wall. Drain excess solvent through until the liquid is 2 to 3 mm above silica gel. A-4.2 Weigh accurately about 0.150 g of the sample

IS 8701 : 1996

into a 50-ml volumetric flask. Dissolve in 2 ml of ethyl acetate, dilute to volume with hexane and mix well. Transfer a 15-ml aliquot to the prepared column. Wash down the side of the column three times with 5-ml portions of 4 percent ethyl acetate in hexane and continue to add until a total of 250 ml of the wash solution has passed through the column. Discard the wash. A-4.3 Place a 1 OOO-mlround-bottomed flask below the column and eluate the temephos by passing through 500 ml of lo-percent ethyl acetate in hexane. Place the flask containing the eluate on a rotary film evaporator, and evaporate to dryness under vacuum using a water bath at 50�C. Remove the flask from the evaporator and add by pipette 100 ml of methanol. Stopper the flask and shake well. Transfer a 5 ml aliquot of this solution to a lOO-ml volumetric flask. Dilute to volume with methanol and mix well. Measure the absorbance at 274 nm in a 1 cm quartz cell using methanol in the reference cell.

A-4.4 Weigh accurately~o. 150 g of reference standard in a 50-ml volumetric flask, add 2 ml of ethyl acetate to disslove, dilute to volume with hexane. Transfer~a 15-ml aliquot to the prepared column and proceed as described above. A-4.5 Calculation Temephos content, percent by mass = where A sample = absorbance r-m% of the sample at 274 A samule .

Standards are also reviewed periodically; a standard along with amendments is reaffirmed when such review indicates that no changes are needed; if the review indicates that changes are needed, it is taken up-for revision.
